criteria.description: Sustained stability: one recorded 300 s soak completes with no leak growth trend, no dropped-event records, and clean teardown
criteria.evidence: evidence/soak-300s.log: 29.43 Hz sustained (first/last third identical), max gap 44.3 ms, 0 lost, page-side 8830/8830 lossless, clean teardown, CREST_ACCEPTANCE passed (skipped: none). Quantified leak metric (analysis finding A1), whole series (soak-300s-rss.samples.log, all 33 samples 10 s apart, 07:13:09-07:18:30Z): opens 507840 KiB, rises once by +99552 KiB to its peak 607392 KiB at sample 2, holds ~607 MiB for ~60 s, drops to 155840 KiB at sample 8 and declines to a 103-107 MiB plateau, ending 94160 KiB (min 93568) - net -413680 KiB, peak 6.45x the final sample. The declared bound (no monotonic growth across sampling windows) is NOT met across the full run - the first window grows - and is met from the peak (sample 2) onward; the opening step is never resumed and every later positive delta is <=592 KiB (<=0.6%), longest consecutive rise two windows totalling +32 KiB. Correction of record: this field previously read 'declining 107728 -> 103904 KiB plateau', which was samples 13-31 of 33 reported as the whole run (shell-hygiene-01KZD0KR post-merge review, RISK-1).
criteria.notes: Plan's <=50 ms p95 visibility goal (analysis finding C1) measured on hardware: p50 7.9 / p95 8.8 / max 10.9 ms.
